name: Agassiwa Maid
source:
I lived a normal life, except that my parents died early in an accident.
I firmly believed that I would live a life no different from others.

"My grandfather left a legacy."

One day, I discovered that the mansion I inherited had five male maids!?
translation:
除了父母早年因意外去世，我一直过着普通的生活。
我深信，自己也会像其他人一样度过一生。

“祖父留下了一笔遗产。”

某一天，我发现继承的宅邸里，竟然有五个男仆？！
